question.problem:
Compute the volume $V$ of the parallelepiped spanned by the vectors $a=⟨4,0,2⟩$, $b=⟨1,3,0⟩$, and $c=⟨0,2,5⟩.$

$V=${{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The volume of a parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot (b\times c) & =|\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =4\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 2 & 5\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}|+2\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =4(3\cdot 5-0\cdot 2)+0+2(1\cdot 2-3\cdot 0) \\  & =60+0+4 \\  & =64\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we take the absolute value. So, the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is 

$$
V=|64|=64.
$$
